### NAME

`testdisk` - Data-recovery tool for lost partitions and filesystems.

### SYNOPSIS

Not derived automatically - see [upstream documentation](https://github.com/cgsecurity/testdisk). This page does not
hand-copy flags (generation contract, ADR-0001).

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

**TestDisk** checks the partition and boot sectors of your disks. It is very useful in recovering lost partitions. It works with: - DOS/Windows FAT12, FAT16 and FAT32 - NTFS (Windows NT/2K/XP) - Linux Ext2 and Ext3 - BeFS (BeOS) - BSD disklabel (FreeBSD/OpenBSD/NetBSD) - CramFS (Compressed File System) - HFS and HFS+, Hierarchical File System - JFS, IBM's Journaled File System - Linux Raid - Linux Swap (versions 1 and 2) - LVM and LVM2, Linux Logical Volume Manager - Netware NSS - ReiserFS 3.5, 3.6 and 4 - Sun Solaris i386 disklabel - UFS and UFS2 (Sun/BSD/...) - XFS, SGI's Journaled File System **PhotoRec** is file data recovery software designed to recover lost pictures from digital camera
